summary.text: J. Lowry Snow is the Utah Forward Party candidate for the Utah State Senate, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging Democratic incumbent Jennifer Plumb alongside Republican Thaddeus A. Evans.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he works in the AI industry and that his top priority is making AI safe for Utah communities.

paragraphs.text: Snow's Ballotpedia profile lists his career experience as working in business development.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his family has served Utah since the late 1800s, that he has lived in the district for 12 years, and that he studied computer science and international business.

Snow said his priorities include AI safety and accountability for AI developers, a more participatory legislative process, housing affordability, and science-based policies for cleaner air and a healthy Great Salt Lake.
